MRI Safety Information
The Garnet Transcatheter Valve is MR Conditional. Patients with this device can be scanned at 1.5 T when all of the following conditions are met.
General conditions:
- Gradient slew rate limited to 150 T/m/s per axis.
- Scan in First Level Controlled Operating Mode.
- Use CP mode only (circularly polarized RF excitation).
- whole body SAR not to exceed 4 W/kg.
- Maximum Head SAR 1 W/kg.
- Maximum active scan time of 60 minutes.
The image artifact extends approximately 40 mm from the device.
RF heating was evaluated using a body coil at 64 MHz and 128 MHz in a gel phantom.
Testing used a maximum gradient amplitude of 40 mT/m.
